Hi, I'll be doing the accessibility review for this project :) Please tag me with questions. 
There are accessible merits to both Option 1 and Option 2: 
* Option 1: Images are shown when the alt-text creator is open, meaning the images can be reviewed as the alt text is composed
* Option 1: Badges are easy to see and do not depend on color to communicate meaning
* Option 2: All images can be reviewed in one list, which doesn't require scrolling the document. 
* Both: Each image has an indicator to show when alt text hasn't been reviewed
* Both: Alt text manipulation is available directly from the image, not solely in the image menu. 

Is it possible to combine these approaches?

Please move the toggle to the left of the associated label, this makes it easier for users who rely on magnification software to find associated controls. See https://scottvinkle.me/blogs/work/proximity-and-zoom

hi @Ryan Casey - do we want to move the focus to this status message? If it's:
1. a `role=status` (as you recommended in the a11y annotations side, for the "A" landmark) and
